magic_items.name: Wine of the Court
magic_items.description: The white glass of this bottle of sweet, dark red wine is made from the sand found along the banks of the Neurabon river. It contains enough for six servings and bears the sigil of Ulorian the First, King of the River Court. A creature who drinks a serving of this wine may speak and understand Aquan for 1 hour. Creatures who drink more than one serving within 24 hours must make a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become incapacitated for 1d4 hours.

magic_items.name: Wine of the River
magic_items.description: Kept in ebon-colored bottles, this sweet, aged wine tastes of citrus and a delicate flower that grows only on at the edge of the Neurabon river. The bottle contains four servings and is embossed with the oar-shaped symbol of Charun. A creature who drinks a serving of this wine may breathe both air and water for 1 hour. Additionally, the imbiber is filled with knowledge about the Arbonesse forest and gains advantage on Intelligence (history) checks about the forest for 1 hour. Creatures who drink more than one serving within 24 hours must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become incapacitated for 1d4 hours.

magic_items.name: Arbonesse Wine
magic_items.description: A creature who drinks a serving of this wine may breathe both air and water for 1 hour. Additionally, the imbiber is filled with knowledge about the Arbonesse forest and gains advantage on Intelligence (history) checks about the forest for 1 hour. Creatures who drink more than one serving within 24 hours must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become incapacitated for 1d4 hours.

magic_items.name: Spell Scroll of Prismatic Spray
magic_items.description: When the hut's former occupant hastily fled, she left behind a case with a scroll of prismatic spray in a desk.

magic_items.name: Orichalcum Chains
magic_items.description: Bind the dolia in these orichalcum chains, and it will do your bidding.

features.name: Blessing of the Neurabon
features.description: The knight gains a swim speed equal to its speed and can breathe air or water whenever it is in the River Neurabon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes two glaive attacks.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Surge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The knight is carried forward by a magical wave of water. It moves its speed in a straight line toward one target and makes a glaive attack, doing an additional 3 (1d6) force damage for every five feet it moves using this ability. Creatures struck by this attack are knocked prone.

features.name: Amphibious

features.name: Speak with Amphibians
features.description: Grummlump can communicate with amphibious creatures.

features.name: Lightning Leap
features.description: As a bonus action, Grummlump can move up to his speed. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. If he lands next to a creature, Grummlump can make a scimitar attack as part of the bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Grummlump makes two scimitar or shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tongue Lash
actions.description: Grummlump's tongue lashes out and grabs an object within 20 feet that can be held in two hands, like a weapon, shield, wand, or other similar item. If the object is unattended, he automatically takes possession of it. If it is attended or wielded, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw to retain possession.

features.name: Cunning
features.description: As a bonus action, Zizzbazz can dash, disengage, or hide on each of her turns in combat.

features.name: Flyby
features.description: Zizzbazz doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when she flies out of an enemy's reach.

features.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
features.description: Zizzbazz deals an extra 17 (5d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Zizzbazz that isn't incapacitated and Zizzbazz doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

monsters.name: Uzit, the Crushing Vengeance
damage_resistances: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Disguise
features.description: While Uzit remains motionless, she is indistinguishable from a pile of rocks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Uzit makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled. While a target is grappled in this way, it is restrained (DC 17 to escape). Uzit can grapple two Large-sized or smaller targets in this manner but loses one slam attack per grappled creature.

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: one or two grappled targets. Uzit can crush each target that is has grappled. The target takes 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

npcs.name: Enetha Senbloom
npcs.description: High Priest of Charun. A tall, pale woman whose robe is made of undulating river plants. The cowl of her robe is made entirely of shaped, black water, which shadows her face and lends a trickling quality to her speech. She spends most of her time in the Spire of Charun where she gives sermons and counsels the court's membership. She travels the Neurabon on a riverboat made from the bones of those enemies of the court who drowned.

npcs.name: Gibbers Crane
npcs.description: Master of the Pluckers. A severe and hard-working halfling who leads the Pluckers—a union of halfling laborers responsible for harvesting the grapes from the wineries of the River Court. He wears patched overalls and a floppy, wide-brimmed hat decorated with a single crane feather. His hands are permanently stained a dark purple color from a lifetime of plucking the magical grapes.

npcs.name: Halliath Moro
equipment: sentient glaive named Torrent with the power to control water and summon elemental guardians
armor made entirely from hardened hydra scales
helm made from the skull of a particularly large hydra
npcs.description: Marshal of the Knights of the Deluge. The leader of the River Court's small unit of elite king's guards, the Knights of the Deluge. He is rarely more than twenty feet from the king and, thanks to Ulorian's magic, has not slept in over seventy years. Moro is a devastating opponent whose armor is made entirely from hardened hydra scales. His helm is made from the skull of a particularly large hydra that he slew single-handedly when it threatened the spires. He wields a sentient glaive named Torrent with the power to control water and summon elemental guardians.
